en.description:
It’s time for a new era! Safe Lane Gaming has taken over the epic game of Battle Camp, stay tuned for more updates and the rebirth of this fantastic game! 

Events - Crush your enemies alone or forge alliances with Rangers to build a Troop! Bring your friends or meet new ones from around the world with real-time messaging.

Troop up! Work together to defeat epic bosses, wage war on other Troops and dominate in REAL-TIME PvP. Battle other Rangers every week in events for your shot at the top of the Leaderboard.

Your style: Design your own unique avatar! You can even customize the clothing as you wish with a massive array of costumes and accessories.

Mentor: Never get lost, use our well designed mentor program in game and in the Facebook community

Facebook Communities - Join our great community on Facebook. We have “Battle Camp Global” for official community, “Battle Camp Global Trading” where you can trade monsters and “Battle Camp Global Learning” for mentor-program to help you evolve as a BC player.  
Get ready for a world that is constantly changing as frequent raids bring new challenges, new worlds and new monsters! What are you waiting for? Download now!

FEATURES
- Catch and evolve 1200+ monsters
- Explore a live virtual world
- Form a troop with friends and other players
- Monster battling puzzle MMO
- Battle rivals in real-time PvP
- Rise to the top of the leaderboard in weekly events
- Design your own unique avatar

PRIVACY POLICY & TERMS OF SERVICE
- Please read our privacy policy at http://battlecamp.com/privacy.html
- By playing Battle Camp, you agree to our terms of service http://battlecamp.com/tos

This update from Apple will improve the functionality of this app. No new features are included.

5.42.0: RAGING RABBITS

{HOLIDAY EVENT} THE GREAT EGG HEIST.
Farmer Brownhare has gone rogue this Easter! Instead of joining the Camp's traditional Egg Hunt, he's been stealing all the eggs for himself.
With his mischievous minion Chickadeath causing chaos, it's up to you to stop them, reclaim the candy, and earn exciting rewards!

{NEW CONTENT} FESTIVE LOOKS HAVE ARRIVED!
Unlock limited-time festive costumes (INCLUDING SIR CATELOT!) before the event ends!

{NEW CONTENT} MYTHIC POWER ON THE RISE!
Brand-new Mythic Monsters have arrived.
Collect and upgrade them to overwhelm your enemies!

{NEW CONTENT} NEW MOSNTERS DISCOVERED!
New multi-element Monsters have entered the Camp!
Deal bonus damage across two elements and expand your strategy.

{NEW CONTENT} EVOLVE AND ASCEND!
Selected Monsters can now reach their second evolution!
Evolve them and unleash their true potential.

{MISC}
Bug fixes and performance improvements.

ja.description:
新しい時代がやってきた！大作ゲームの「BattleCamp」は、SafeLaneGaming社が引き継ぐこととなりました。今後のアップデートや、この素晴らしいゲームの復活にご期待ください。

イベント：一人で敵を粉砕するか、レンジャーと同盟を結び、兵力を編成しよう！リアルタイムのメッセージングで、友人を招待したり、世界中の新しい友達に出会ったりすることができます。

結集しよう！協力して巨大なボスを倒し、他の軍隊と戦いながら、リアルタイムのPvPで権勢を振るいましょう。リーダーボードのトップに上るために、イベントで毎週他のレンジャーと戦います。

あなたのスタイル：独自のユニークなアバターをデザインしよう！たくさんのコスチュームやアクセサリーを使って、好きなように服をカスタマイズすることもできます。

メンター：迷子にならないように、ゲーム内やFacebookコミュニティで優れたメンタープログラムを使用する

Facebookコミュニティ：Facebookで素敵なコミュニティに参加してください。公式コミュニティ向けの「BattleCampGlobal」、モンスターをトレードできる「BattleCampGlobalTrading」、BCプレイヤーとしての進化を支援するメンタープログラム向けの学習グループ「BattleCampGlobalLearning」があります。


頻繁にレイドを行うごとに、現れる新しい課題、新しい世界、新しいモンスター、そして変化し続ける世界に備えよう！何をためらっていますか？今すぐダウンロード！

特徴
- 1,200匹以上のモンスターを捕まえて進化させる
- 生き生きした仮想世界を探検する
- 友達や他のプレイヤーと軍隊を編成する
- モンスターバトルパズルMMO
- リアルタイムPvPでライバルとバトル
- 毎週のイベントでリーダーボードのトップに上る
- 独自のアバターをデザインする

プライバシーポリシーと利用規約
-当社のプライバシーポリシー（http://battlecamp.com/privacy.html）をお読みください。
-BattleCampをプレイすることにより、当社の利用規約（http://battlecamp.com/tos）に同意したことになります。

de.description:
Zeit für eine neue Ära! Safe Lane Gaming hat das epische Spiel Battle Camp übernommen. Bleib dran für weitere Updates und die Wiedergeburt dieses fantastischen Spiels! 

Events - Zerstöre deine Feinde allein oder schmiede Allianzen mit Rangern, um eine Truppe zu bilden! Bringe deine Freunde mit oder begegne neuen Freunden aus der ganzen Welt mit Echtzeit-Messaging.

Truppe bilden! Verbünde dich, um epische Bosse zu besiegen, führe Krieg gegen andere Truppen und dominiere im ECHTZEIT-PvP. Kämpfe jede Woche in Events gegen andere Ranger, um an die Spitze der Rangliste zu gelangen.

Dein Stil: Gestalte deinen eigenen einzigartigen Avatar! Du kannst sogar die Kleidung nach deinen Vorstellungen mit einer riesigen Auswahl an Kostümen und Accessoires anpassen.

Wir haben "Battle Camp Global" für die offizielle Community, "Battle Camp Global Trading", wo du mit Monstern handeln kannst, und "Battle Camp Global Learning" als Mentorenprogramm, das dir hilft, sich als BC-Spieler weiterzuentwickeln. 


Mache dich bereit für eine Welt, die sich ständig verändert, denn häufige Raids bringen neue Herausforderungen, neue Welten und neue Monster! Worauf wartest du? Jetzt herunterladen!

FEATURES
- Fange und entwickle 1200+ Monster
- Erkunde eine lebendige virtuelle Welt
- Bilde eine Truppe mit Freunden und anderen Spielern
- Monster-Kampf-Puzzle-MMO
- Kämpfe gegen Rivalen in Echtzeit-PvP
- Steige in wöchentlichen Events an die Spitze der Rangliste.
- Gestalte deinen eigenen einzigartigen Avatar

DATENSCHUTZRICHTLINIE & SERVICEBEDINGUNGEN
- Bitte lese unsere Datenschutzrichtlinie auf http://battlecamp.com/privacy.html
- Indem du Battle Camp spielst, erklärst du dich mit unseren Nutzungsbedingungen einverstanden http://battlecamp.com/tos

5.29.0: DREAM REAVER!

{HALLOWEEN EVENT} PUMPKIN PERIL!
Greetings, fearless adventurers! The mischievous Angelique has taken over our beloved River Crossing, and chaos reigns. She's notorious for protecting herself whenever we get close.

BUT FEAR NOT, for we have a plan: offer her some Mind's Eye to keep her grounded and end her haunting attacks.

Her faithful partner, Mrs. Wind Walker, guards her with unwavering loyalty. We seek your aid in vanquishing Angelique and reclaiming River Crossing. Stand with us in this battle and prove to these demons that Halloween won't be overshadowed!

{NEW CONTENT} HAUNTING HOLIDAY ATTIRE!
Unveil spine-tingling new costumes before the Halloween season draws to a close!

{NEW CONTENT} EERIE AND ENHANCED MYTHICS!
New Mythic Monsters have risen from the depths and await your command! Bolster their strength and terrorize your adversaries!

{NEW CONTENT} OTHERWORLDLY MONSTERS!
Otherworldly multi-element monsters have breached our Camp's boundaries! These spectral beings inflict bonus damage for two distinct elements.

{NEW CONTENT} EVOLVE OR VANISH INTO THE MISTS!
Fresh creatures have transcended their limitations to unlock their second evolution! Seize their destructive potential by evolving them with Crystals.

{MISC} 
Bug Fixes and tweaks.

{CHRISTMAS EVENT} TROLLIVER'S CHAOTIC GIFT!
'Tis the season of chaos as Trolliver, disgruntled from Santa's Naughty List, threats to wreck our Christmas party once again! Distract him with the gift of Coal to turn his destructive spree into epic battles! Beware Slaybell, his fierce companion on a bitting rampage!

{NEW ATTIRE} Festive costumes unveiled! Get ready for warm and cosy, Christmas fashion!

{ENHANCED MYTHICS} Dive into the depths with new Mythic Monsters! Strengthen them to terrorize your foes!

{OTHERWORLDLY MONSTERS} Witness the breach of multi-element beings! Inflict bonus damage with spectral creatures!

{EVOLUTION UNLEASHED} Unlock second evolutions! Harness their power with Crystals before they vanish into the mists. Save Christmas!

{VALENTINE'S DAY EVENT} CUPID'S LAST STAND!

Cdr. Cupid has arrived, ready to draft everyone into the battlefield of love... by shooting arrows at them. But fear not! Offering his comfort food (Chocolate!) could divert his attention from love arrows to more noble pursuits, like battling.

Beware of Cdr. Cupid's loyal recruit, Tough Stuft, who couldn't care less about love but is determined to get this over with. He'll do whatever it takes to get you in Cupid's line of fire.

{NEW ATTIRE} Romantic outfits revealed! Get ready to dazzle in elegant Valentine's fashion!

{ENHANCED LEGENDARIES} Delve into the depths with new Legendary Creatures! Power them up to dominate your adversaries!

{OTHERWORLDLY CREATURES} Encounter the arrival of multi-element entities! Deal extra damage with ethereal beasts!

{HOLIDAY EVENT} SPOOKY SEASON IS HERE!
Zophar, the King of the Underworld, and his trusty pup Sparky have taken over the Camp, demanding no tricks or treats this year! Are you ready to take on King Zophar and save the holiday spirit once again?

{NEW CONTENT} GET NEW COSTUMES!
Don't miss out on our spooktacular new costumes! Grab the latest costumes before some spooky fiends snatch them away!

{NEW CONTENT} STRONGER MYTHICS!
A host of powerful new Mythic Monsters has arrived! Strengthen your collection and unleash their might!

{NEW CONTENT} BRAND NEW MONSTERS!
Dive into the adventure with exciting new multi-element monsters! These creatures deal bonus damage across two element types, giving you the edge in battle!

{NEW CONTENT} NEW EVOLUTIONS!

{HOLIDAY EVENT} WINTER IS COMING!
Mr. Winter is back, and he's not in the holiday spirit! Rally your Troop to stop him from freezing Christmas.
Beware the Winter Warrior, Mr. Winter's frosty defender, as you battle to save the Holiday!

{HOLIDAY EVENT} CELEBRATE CHINESE NEW YEAR!
The Year of the Snake has arrived! Join the celebration and help the Campers to protect the festival from the evil Tower Warden.
Light your fireworks, collect trophies, and restore harmony to the festivities!

{NEW CONTENT} HOLIDAY COSTUMES!
Dress your characters in stunning outfits inspired by Chinese New Year traditions!

{NEW CONTENT} FESTIVE NEW MONSTERS!
A collection of new creatures has appeared to bring good fortune. Add these powerful beasts to your roster!

{NEW CONTENT} THIRD EVOLUTIONS!

5.36.0: FINAL JUDGEMENT!

{HOLIDAY EVENT} CARNIVAL CHAOS!
Queen Magnolia despises Carnival! The sight of people celebrating in the streets fills her with rage. She shuts her ears to the rhythms of Samba, refusing to accept the joy it brings. But maybe some well-placed Masketta can make her feel the rhythm! Help bring the spirit of Carnival to the Queen and see if her heart can keep up with the beat!

{NEW CONTENT} CARNIVAL COSTUMES!
Dress your characters in vibrant, festive outfits inspired by the energy and color of Carnival!

{NEW CONTENT} GROOVY NEW MONSTERS!
New creatures have arrived to join the celebration! Add them to your team and march to victory!

{NEW CONTENT} FINAL EVOLUTIONS!
Unlock the ultimate power of your strongest monsters with brand-new final evolutions!

5.37.0: FEAST, FIGHT, FEATHERS!

{HOLIDAY EVENT} CHICKEN COCKY QUEST!
Campers, we've got a sticky situation! Chucko the candy-crazed chicken is swooping in and snatching all our sweet Easter treats! Every time we chase him off, he flaps right back!
But fear not — we've hatched a plan: lure him with Chocolead and ground that greedy bird for good!
He's not alone, though. ANTagonist is circling around and won't let us take Chucko down easily. Rally with your team to stop their chaos and save the holiday snacks!

{NEW CONTENT} FRESH FESTIVE FASHION!
Celebrate in style with limited-time holiday outfits—grab them before they're gone!

{NEW CONTENT} MYTHIC MONSTER MIGHT!
Powerful new Mythic Monsters have arrived — add them to your team and dominate your rivals!

{NEW CONTENT} ELEMENTAL HYBRIDS	!
Introducing brand-new monsters with dual elements! Double the element, double the trouble.

{NEW CONTENT} SECOND EVOLUTIONS!
Certain monsters have reached new evolutionary heights! Unleash their next form and harness epic new abilities.

{MISC}
Bug fixes and overall game polish.

{HOLIDAY EVENT} RETURN OF THE DREAM REAVER!
The Queen of Dreams has returned! Angelique haunts River Crossing once more, summoning a twisted vision of Wind Walker's mother to torment the world. But fear not — her nightmare is only another cruel illusion! Rally your troop, gather Mind's Eyes, and banish Angelique's horrors before they spread.

{HOLIDAY EVENT} NAUGHTY AND ICE!
Elfie and Gingerbread are furious about missing out on gifts once again, and now they're plotting to snatch every present in Camp!
Elfie can't be harmed thanks to her frozen heart… but a warm cup of Hot Cocoa might do the trick! Join forces with your Troop to thaw her icy heart and help spread Christmas cheer throughout Camp!
